title: PV Power Estimated
description: A single time period of PV power output data returned by Solcast's live, forecast, historic, and TMY PV power endpoints.

period_end.description: End time of the data period in UTC (ISO 8601).

period.description: Duration of the time period in ISO 8601 duration format.

pv_estimate.description: Estimated PV power output as a fraction of system capacity (0–1, where 1 = full capacity).

pv_estimate10.description: PV estimate at the 10th percentile — pessimistic scenario (0–1).

pv_estimate90.description: PV estimate at the 90th percentile — optimistic scenario (0–1).

pv_power_rooftop.description: Estimated rooftop PV power output in kilowatts (kW).

pv_power_advanced.description: Advanced model PV power output in kilowatts (kW) for registered sites.
